instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Manrope' for all headings to give a modern, geometric feel.
Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text to maintain corporate legibility.
Implement the 'Active Notch' in the sidebar: Active items must have a left border (border-l-4 border-blue-500) to simulate a folder tab.
Do NOT use full-width cards for everything. Use the page background (slate-50) and place white cards ONLY for grouped data.
Ensure all tables have a 'dense' feel (text-sm, p-3) to accommodate HR data density.
For the Auth page, use the 'auth_background' image on the left side with a blue overlay to ensure text readability if you place text over it.
All interactive elements must have 'data-testid' attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) sparingly (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
